policy.title: Extend the reports-style version-gated baseline to task writes
policy.recommendation: Apply the existing `x-client-contract: v2` + `assertBaselineForModernClient` + `assertLegacyCompatAllowed` pattern (editPolicy.ts:19,23,44-57,117-141) to task online writes (PUT /:id, PATCH /:id/status, POST /batch/status) and the sync `tasks` entity. Modern clients MUST send a baseline (expectedUpdatedAt online / baseUpdatedAt offline); missing baseline is rejected for modern clients.

policy.title: Missing-base handling (modern vs legacy)
policy.recommendation: Modern client missing baseline -> reject with 400/409 CONCURRENCY_BASELINE_REQUIRED (no silent fallback). Legacy client missing baseline -> allow only inside a time-boxed compatibility window for non-critical states, audited as noConcurrencyBaseline (mirror reports). Tasks legacy window parameters TBD by owner.

policy.title: Conflict (409) interaction
policy.recommendation: When a present-and-stale baseline is detected (or concurrent CAS fails), server returns conflict with the server snapshot (updatedAt). Online: 409 CONFLICT. Offline: SyncChange status 'conflict' + server snapshot, stored per-user; client resolveConflict supports 'server' (discard) and 'local' (re-push with server.updatedAt as new base). Missing base never yields a conflict.

policy.title: Upgrade window and cutoff
policy.recommendation: Define a minimum client version that must send a baseline and a dated cutoff after which allowLegacyCompat is flipped false (first for reports, then tasks). Cutoff date is OPEN_INPUT (see support-evidence-register UC-1/UC-2).

policy.title: Field/status/assignee full-chain scope
policy.recommendation: Cover ordinary fields, status, and assigneeId together (mixed PUT transaction) plus batch/status and offline sync upsert. The offline report enqueue gap (ReportEdit.tsx:358, no baseUpdatedAt) must also be closed so report offline matches report online.

riskAcceptance.text: Until the legacy window closes, legacy clients without a baseline retain stale-overwrite exposure on tasks. Acceptable only with an explicit, dated sunset and owner sign-off.

note: This draft does not alter the existing T-RP-03 registration status (PROPOSED). It is preparation material for the decision owner; it does not approve strict CAS or modify any code.
